finding.headline: "The 6-Week Shock"
finding.problem: "The nurse said my stomach muscles are split and I just stared. Nobody told me this could happen. I went home and cried and Googled 'am I broken?'"
finding.person: Ngozi, 28, first-time mum in Enugu, told at her 6-week postnatal check "you have a 2-finger gap" and given no plan.
finding.competition_notes: See RESEARCH BASE section of source report.

disposition.rationale: Report assigns: "Standalone product (diagnosis-to-action bridge)". Verdict: PASSES.
